test_title: PYST 39: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘FULLY’ is written as ‘ETKKX’ and ‘GIVEN’ is written as ‘FHUDM’. How will ‘EARLY’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic here follows is:

FULLY is written as ETKKX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5734a2582011c2ae477f7edf5489e1f9c6722e48620e8e3e739e80c48a4f6c83.png] 

GIVEN is written as FHUDM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73122f6b2e99c866bde49963c69eb154f8ba1932bde94e963373aa2329e32966.png] 

Similarly, EARLY will be written as DZQKX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4093a598286bfb0d6b834f6fe0b468894626ad036fcaf756505e85197a47170e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **__DZQKX__**.
